metrics.source: Wikipedia + CENTCOM + CBS + Guardian live coverage

metrics.label: Iranian Missiles Launched (Regional Conflict Total)
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence + IDF spokesperson + ISW/CTP + OSINT public reporting (launches only)
metrics.scope: Total reported Iranian missile launches across the regional 2026 conflict (cumulative lower bound). Excludes U.S./Israeli air strikes.
metrics.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence + IDF spokesperson + ISW/CTP + OSINT public reporting (launches only)

metrics.label: Iranian Drones Launched (Regional Conflict Total)
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence + IDF spokesperson + ISW/CTP + OSINT public reporting (launches only)
metrics.scope: Total reported Iranian drone launches across the regional 2026 conflict (cumulative lower bound). Excludes U.S./Israeli air strikes.
metrics.source_name: UAE Ministry of Defence + IDF spokesperson + ISW/CTP + OSINT public reporting (launches only)

metrics.label: Total Reported Killed
metrics.source: Wikipedia + ISW + ACLED + OCHA + public reporting
metrics.scope: Aggregate reported deaths across tracked parties (source-mixed civilian+military where not separated).
metrics.source_name: Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war (all tracked countries, conservative lower bound)

metrics.label: Total Reported Injured
metrics.source: Wikipedia + ISW + ACLED + OCHA + public reporting
metrics.scope: Aggregate reported injured across tracked parties (source-mixed civilian+military where not separated).
metrics.source_name: Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war (all tracked countries, conservative lower bound)

metrics.label: Air Defense Intercepts (Conflict Lower Bound)
metrics.source: UAE Ministry of Defence / WAM public cumulative tally
metrics.scope: Publicly documented cumulative intercepts / engagements. Current floor comes from UAE official cumulative tally through March 27, 2026, and undercounts theater-wide interceptions.
metrics.source_name: UAE air defences cumulative tally through March 27, 2026

metrics.label: Critical Infrastructure / Civilian Site Impacts (Reported Floor)
metrics.source: Iranian Red Crescent via Anadolu
metrics.scope: Current reported floor from the Iranian Red Crescent: over 113,000 damaged civilian places since February 28, 2026. This is not an exact total for all theater-wide infrastructure damage and should be read as a minimum reported count.
metrics.source_name: Iran says over 113,000 civilian places damaged in US-Israeli attacks

metrics.label: Conflict Duration (days)
metrics.source: Computed from war start date
metrics.scope: Elapsed calendar days since February 28, 2026, inclusive.

metrics.label: Air Strikes (Reported Floor)
metrics.source: Britannica: 2026 Iran conflict
metrics.scope: Conservative floor for reported U.S./Israeli air strikes against Iran. Britannica reports nearly 900 strikes in the first 12 hours on February 28, 2026; the campaign continued after that, so this should be read as a minimum rather than an exact total.
